title: Veri-Sure: Multi-Agent RTL Code Generation with Temporal Tracing, Slicing and Formal Verification
abstract: arXiv:2601.19747v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In the rapidly evolving field of Electronic Design Automation (EDA), the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) for Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation has emerged as a promising direction. However, because RTL code describes concurrent hardware behavior with strict cycle-level timing and thus differs fundamentally from software code, LLM-based RTL code generation remains bottlenecked by (i) sparse feedback and limited test coverage of simulation-centric evaluation, (ii) regressions and repair hallucinations introduced by whole-file regeneration during debugging, and (iii) semantic drift as intent is reinterpreted across repair iterations and agent handoffs. In this work, we propose Veri-Sure, a multi-agent framework that establishes a design contract to align agents' intent and uses a patching mechanism guided by static dependency slicing to perform precise, localized repairs. translated_title: Veri-Sure：基于时序追踪、切片与形式化验证的多智能体RTL代码生成
translated_abstract: 在快速发展的电子设计自动化（EDA）领域中，部署大语言模型（LLM）进行寄存器传输级（RTL）代码生成已成为一个有前景的方向。然而，由于RTL代码描述的是具有严格周期级时序的并发硬件行为，与软件代码有着本质区别，基于LLM的RTL代码生成仍受制于以下瓶颈：（i）以仿真为中心的评估方法反馈稀疏且测试覆盖有限；（ii）调试过程中的整文件重新生成引入了回归问题和修复幻觉；（iii）随着意图在修复迭代和智能体交接过程中被反复重新解释而产生语义漂移。在本工作中，我们提出了Veri-Sure，这是一个多智能体框架，它通过建立设计契约来对齐各智能体的意图，并采用由静态依赖切片引导的补丁机制来执行精确的局部化修复。通过集成多分支验证……
tldr: Veri-Sure是一个多智能体RTL代码生成框架，通过设计契约对齐智能体意图、静态依赖切片引导的局部化补丁修复以及形式化验证与时序追踪，解决了LLM生成RTL代码中反馈稀疏、整文件重生成引发回归和语义漂移三大瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Veri-Sure is a multi-agent RTL code generation framework that overcomes sparse simulation feedback, regressions from whole-file regeneration, and semantic drift by establishing design contracts, performing static dependency slicing-guided localized patching, and leveraging temporal tracing and formal verification.
